name: Earth warriors

variantInfo.name: Earth warrior
notes: Level 51 Earth warrior in the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness levels 7-10); 54 hitpoints, max hit 5.
Reached via the monkey bars, which require 15 Agility.
Crush is their weakest melee defence (+20); 11 spawns in a single-combat area with a safespot.

locationComparison.name: Earth warriors (Edgeville Dungeon)
notes: 11 Earth warrior spawns in the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness).
Reached via the monkey bars (15 Agility). Single-combat area; a cannon can be used and a safespot exists in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber.

taskNotes: Earth warriors are assigned only by Krystilia and must be killed in the Wilderness to count; there is no combat, Slayer or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 257 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Earth warriors are in the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness levels 7-10), reached via the monkey bars which require 15 Agility.
Crush is their weakest melee defence (+20); magic defence is +10.
The area is single-combat, a cannon can be used, and there is a safespot in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber.
No task extension unlock exists for Earth warriors.
recommendedMethod: Cross the Edgeville Dungeon monkey bars (15 Agility) to the north-eastern Earth warrior chamber and kill them with a crush weapon against their weakest defence (+20). A cannon can be used and a safespot exists for lower-level players.
